hints.title: Spreadsheet Dependency Representation
hints.text: Cells contain either fixed values or composite formula ranges that resolve dynamically upon query.

hints.title: Formula String Range Expansion
hints.text: Parse strings like A1 or A1:B2 to expand into cell coordinate occurrences, storing coefficient frequencies for each cell.

hints.title: Excel Grid Blueprint
hints.text: Store grid[r][c] with val and formula map. get(r, c): if no formula, return val; else compute sum of count * get(nr, nc) recursively. set(r, c, v): clear formula and set val = v. sum(r, c, numbers): parse ranges into formula dict, return get(r, c).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Dynamic recursive evaluation traverses dependent cells on demand.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Eager recomputation without cycle tracking or dependency updates leads to stale values upon deep updates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Formula frequency map stores cell dependencies compactly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Parsing rectangular ranges like A1:B3 and handling dynamic recalculations.
